text:
rachel: heads-up qbench on qsmol shows emoji normalization in quant runtime collapsed distinct prompts into same fingerprint. pinging @labeling-team.
owen: example? exact collapse or similar tokens?
rachel: example: 'Thanks! 🙏' and 'Thanks 🙏🏻' -> both normalized to same canonical emoji and produced identical fingerprint. lost paraphrase signal.
priya: ah, we normalize grapheme clusters differently in runtime v2.1. that explains it. how many affected?
dan: qbench counted ~2.4k fingerprint collisions across prompt_gold_light (bank 95k). ~180 anchors with golden labels.
label-bot: export queued: `export_prompts --set prompt_gold_light --filter "emoji_norm_conflict=true" --out s3://redwood/tmp/emoji_conflicts.json` (job 9981)
owen: plan: small A/B (10k slice) comparing current fingerprint vs emoji-preserving fallback (store raw unicode as part of fingerprint).
priya: labelers: expect minor requeue. contractor lead ok to add 1 reviewer for 2 hrs. golden edits require two approvers per policy.
rachel: i'll add repro + dry-run re-fingerprint script to infra repo and open PR today. will also include migration provenance fields.
owen: once PR is up i'll run A/B and report dup rate + label churn.
priya: also sweep int8/int4 builds to ensure no other normalization changes.
dan: ops created calendar: "emoji-fingerprint-rescue" tomorrow 11:00-12:30 PT.
rachel: thanks, updating thread as PR and results appear. :sparkles:
